findings.title: Keep the registered metric-alert handler instantiable
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits abstract methods from StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of them, so it cannot be instantiated. Accessing Detector.detector_handler for the registered `metric_alert_fire` type now raises TypeError instead of returning the previous no-op handler. process_detectors does not catch that exception, so including such a detector aborts packet processing. Implement the required hooks or retain a concrete no-op handler until the stateful implementation is ready.

findings.title: Build the expected occurrence for the group key being evaluated
findings.body: The expected occurrence in test_dedupe is built for `val1`, while the subsequent evaluate_group_key_value call evaluates `group_key`. The helper includes this key in the occurrence fingerprint, so the expected fingerprint is `<detector_id>:val1` while the actual fingerprint is `<detector_id>:group_key`. The result comparison therefore fails for a correct implementation. Build the expected occurrence using `group_key` as well.
